CustomField.description: The date/time that a presentation in this specific Yesware sent email was most recently viewed. Only counts opens for Yesware tracked presentations.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Yesware will automatically update this field every time a presentation is viewed in the Yesware sent email represented by this Task. This field captures the date/time of the most recent presentation view, only for Yesware tracked presentations.
CustomField.label: Yesware Last Presentation View At
